facts.fact: CAMIX states its third point of presence, at the ST-DIGITAL data centre (carrier hotel), has been in service since 1 July with two members connected, INK and ST-DIGITAL; the article is dated 7 April 2026 yet says 1 July, year not restated, taken as 2026.
CAMIX says its interconnection infrastructure already had two operational sites, a Douala PoP at CAMTEL Bepanda and a Yaounde PoP at the CAMPOST data centre, before the third PoP at ST-DIGITAL.

note: Not facts: SANCFIS and Afri-IX connecting, and talks with Orange, MTN and CAMTEL, are in preparation only.
